docx / xlsx / pptx 的文档属性: Document properties of docx / xlsx / pptx

从浏览器下载时记录的网址: URL recorded when the file was downloaded in a browser

同一个整理文件夹里有内容完全相同的文件；最早修改的一份算原件，不算重复: Files with identical content in the same tidy folder; the earliest-modified copy counts as the original, not a duplicate
后台监听文件夹并直接整理，可在历史里撤销；移到回收站仍需你确认: Watches folders in the background and tidies right away; undo in History. Moving to the Trash still needs your confirmation

拖动调整列表及拖入文件的匹配顺序；文件夹优先级在整理页调整: Drag to set the matching order for the list and dropped files; folder priority is set on the Tidy page

直接编辑 YAML 适合熟悉格式的用户。只有通过校验才会保存；在界面里再次修改规: Editing the YAML directly is for users familiar with the format. Changes are saved only if they pass validation; handwritten comments are removed when you edit rules in the UI again.

第一层的文件和文件夹总数: Total number of top-level files and folders
